run_xds_test_client: run the xDS test client on Kubernetes with a specified server target and QPS
cleanup_xds_test_client: cleanup the xDS test client resources and optionally delete the Kubernetes namespace
run_secure_client: run the xDS test client in secure mode using the client-secure deployment template
configure_client_runner: configure a KubernetesClientRunner with deployment name, image, service account, and network flags
manage_k8s_namespace: manage a Kubernetes namespace for the xDS test client using KubernetesApiManager
